title: Read several objects
summary: GraphQL: Read several objects. Add a third book to the resolver result.
introduction: Square brackets describe a list type. The query selects title for each book.
learningObjectives: Add a third book to the resolver result

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Read several objects

blocks.text: The resolver returns two book objects. GraphQL reads title from each one.
Add a third book to the resolver result.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The list item shape must match the schema type.
